title: Spectral Uniformity of the Even-Dimensional Inverse
summary: A bound is established in odd dimensions, but its proof does not reach the non-APN even-dimensional inverse; prove or refute the conjectured spectral-uniformity value.

formal_statement.body: For even $n$, prove or refute that the inverse permutation on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ has spectral uniformity $2^{n/2}+2$. A bound is established for the inverse function when $n$ is odd, but that proof does not cover even $n$, where the inverse function is not APN; thus the stated value remains a conjectured target for the even-dimensional case.

scope.domain: Spectral uniformity of inverse permutations over binary finite fields.
parameters: n: dimension of the binary vector space
scope.unresolved_remainder: Prove or refute that the inverse permutation has spectral uniformity $2^{n/2}+2$ for even $n$.
